title: Protection warrior at 0 rage at the pull: Bloodrage and melee within seconds, no stall

rules.desc: A Protection warrior that starts the pull with no rage casts Bloodrage within 10 s of the fight starting
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:236-246 (bloodrage row at ACTION_HIGH + 2: the opener that jump-starts the rotation); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/WarriorTriggers.h:65 (BloodrageBuffTrigger, a buff trigger); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/WarriorActions.h:446 (CastBloodrageAction); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: the row is below every taunt and threat builder, so the first seconds go to the taunt on the DPS player's mob first; Bloodrage costs no global cooldown but whether it lands inside 10 s is the open question

rules.desc: A Protection warrior at 0 rage deals damage to the mob (a white swing or any ability) within 8 s of the fight starting: no stall while rage is empty
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:39-42 (the default combat action is melee at ACTION_IDLE); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: the default action keeps the warrior swinging in melee whatever its rage; the mob stands on the player next to it. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649

rules.desc: Precondition: the warrior's rage is under 30 percent at its first hits (a hire that stood 20 s before the pull holds no rage: rage decays out of combat), so the two rules above test the empty-rage opening
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the bot's own rage in the first 5 s of the fight
rules.why_expect: a GM-levelled hire never fought, and rage decays out of combat, so it starts empty; a repeat that starts with rage shows here instead of passing silently

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
